description: This file declares the 'Stop' class, which is a task for stopping a Web Audio player within the Rialto server component. It includes necessary interfaces and defines the class with a constructor, destructor, and execute method.

classes.name: Stop
classes.description: A task class responsible for stopping the Web Audio player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Stop task with a reference to the Web Audio player.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the stop operation on the Web Audio player.
